approval.scope: The complete male v3 body, original identity layer and 240 × 320 registration are approved and locked. This foundation approval does not approve any male garment, runtime integration or publication.

visualQA.scope: Independent review of the actual v3 exported full figure and opaque light/dark enlarged neck views found a continuous broad neck, centered head and no detached local fragments or obvious repair seam. Native sprite resolution remains unchanged.

fullBodyInvariant.rule: Keep every body and identity pixel, silhouette, alpha value, anatomy, pose, head/hair position, hands and feet unchanged. Add one coherent registered outfit overlay, with separate depth layers only where a robe requires occlusion; never regenerate, replace, stretch, shift, clip or mask the body to fit clothing. Normal garment occlusion over the intact body is allowed. A body revision requires a separate explicit request and new founder approval.

identityConstruction.source: Exact original v3 identity candidate; not a new face or neck overlay.

requestedWorkOrder: Fit and review one coherent male everyday outfit overlay on this immutable foundation.
Fit and review one male robe geometry template over the accepted everyday outfit.
After template acceptance, create all male class robe surface variants with unchanged template geometry.
Fit and review one coherent male Woodland Scout outfit overlay.
backlog: Neutral Woodland Scout remains unfinished backlog; the latest founder request prioritizes the male sequence.
garmentRules: Clothes fit the locked body; the body never changes to fit clothes.

Every new everyday, casual or Woodland Scout outfit is one coherent full-outfit illustration and one registered overlay. Do not split shirt, trousers and boots into component exports, warp them independently or assemble independently fitted pieces.
Each male garment family requires its own accepted geometry and registration. Female and neutral assets provide design references, not substitute body fits.
Keep rear cloth behind the complete body and foreground cloth in front. Preserve natural neck joins, complete cuff rims and clear hand silhouettes.

Robe front/rear/cuff layers preserve necessary occlusion within one coherent garment; they do not permit modular outfit mixing. Existing approved assets and historical records remain fixed; no retroactive regeneration is authorized.
Once a garment template is accepted, reuse its exact geometry, registration and layer masks for colors, patterns and flourishes.
Inspect actual exported composites at native and enlarged sizes on light and dark backgrounds; independently review foundational fits before founder acceptance.
runtimeStatus: Versioned foundation files are preserved in the runtime asset directory only. Existing runtime body selection and application code are unchanged.
